name: School Watch - USA
description:
Find private schools, independent schools, international schools, and other fee-paying schools in the United States that could benefit from School Watch.

School Watch is a school management platform that helps schools manage students, teachers, classes, attendance, timetables, exams, parent communication, student follow-up, fees, payments, and parent access from one platform.

The goal is to identify schools where School Watch could improve day-to-day school administration and strengthen communication between the school and parents.
researchInstructions:
Find real private, independent, or international schools operating in the United States. One real school = one prospect. Merge duplicates from different sources.

Priority markets (in order): New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Houston, Miami, Dallas, San Francisco, Washington DC. Also cover: Boston, Atlanta, Seattle, Philadelphia, San Diego, Austin, Denver, Phoenix, Charlotte, San Jose, Orlando, Tampa, Minneapolis, Detroit, Portland.

Prefer independent private schools, preparatory schools, and international schools. Exclude public school districts and charter-only networks unless they are clearly fee-paying private schools.

Target school types only: private schools, independent schools, international schools, private primary/elementary, private secondary/high schools, independent preparatory schools, independent senior/all-through schools, international colleges (K-12 / secondary), private/independent boarding schools.

Prioritize schools with evidence of: multiple grade/year groups, significant student population, multiple teachers, parent communication needs, attendance management, fee collection, parent portals, student administration, multiple campuses, boarding, complex school administration.

Contact methods: Email and WhatsApp. Prefer official school email, admissions, administration, head of school/principal/headmaster, school business manager, operations manager, official WhatsApp. Do not guess emails. Do not use private personal contacts unless clearly published as official school contacts.

Excluded (LOW qualify / reject): public/state/government schools, school districts/boards, universities, higher-education-only colleges, daycare/nursery-only, tutoring centers, private tutors, online education platforms, training centers, language schools (unless full private schools with enrolled students across grades), exam prep centers, educational consultants, recruitment agencies, school suppliers, uniform/equipment suppliers, transportation companies, education/teacher job listings.

Every prospect MUST have at least one source URL proving it is an actual school (official website, contact/admissions page, school directories, association registries, inspection/registration sources). Never invent school name, website, email, phone, WhatsApp, contact name, or job title. Leave unverified fields empty.

Qualification: High (80%+) for private/independent schools with multiple grades, large population, boarding, parent portal, fee-paying, complex admin. Medium for established private/independent with teachers and grades. Low for public/state, universities, tutors, training, consultancies, suppliers, recruitment, no physical school. Minimum qualification target: 80%.

Outreach goal: introduce School Watch to owners, principals, heads of school, directors, and school management for a short demo covering students, teachers, classes, attendance, timetables, exams, student follow-up, parent communication, fees, payments, outstanding balances, and parent access.
